PM Modi Urges Youth to Combat Drug Menace Via Social Media

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called upon the nation's youth to actively participate in the anti-drug campaign by creating social media content, including slogans and songs. He emphasized their role in making India drug-free. Modi also highlighted the success of the PM SVANidhi scheme, noting that approximately 35 lakh women have benefited from it, contributing to their economic empowerment.
